text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commission to promote employment prepares action programme for National Commission.
- Education ministry official suspended and four other officials arrested in scandal over food aid for school meals.
- Moroccan Association for Support of Palestinian People's Struggle says authorities refuse permission for march planned for Monday to protest against Israeli "bloody repression" last week.
- Palestinian police active to prevent confrontation with Israeli army.
- Employment commission to submit 15 proposals to National Commission on battle against unemployment.
- No "big problems or big difficulties" between Morocco and Spain, says Interior Minister Driss Basri on two day visit to Madrid
- Around 20 heifers found dead on ship carrying 35 from France to Moroccan port of Casablanca.
- Security of supplies and safeguarding of environment have been Morocco's main concerns over energy in past three years, says Energy Minister Abdellatif Guerraoui.
